name: Garden Deluxe Room
note: sample room details — confirm size, bed, occupancy and price
summary: A calm room opening toward the lawns, with a warm, uncluttered feel.
description:
The Garden Deluxe Room is our everyday favourite — a bright, restful space finished in warm, paper-soft tones. Large windows look toward the garden, filling the room with daylight.

It is sized for couples and small families who want comfort without fuss, with a generous bed, a quiet work corner and all the essentials for an easy stay.

name: Premium Room
note: sample room details — confirm size, bed, occupancy and price
summary: A roomier stay with an upgraded bed and a lounge chair to unwind.
description:
The Premium Room gives you a little more space and a few more comforts. A plush king bed anchors the room, with a reading chair by the window and considered lighting for evenings in.

It suits travellers who want extra room to spread out, whether in Sagar for work or a relaxed weekend.

name: Executive Suite
note: sample suite details — confirm size, layout, occupancy and price
summary: A separate sitting area and bedroom for guests who want room to host.
description:
The Executive Suite separates living and sleeping into two distinct spaces, so you can take a call or welcome a guest without disturbing the bedroom.

Finished with richer textures and a larger bathroom, it is our choice for longer stays and visiting families who value a little more privacy.

name: Family Suite
note: sample suite details — confirm size, bedding, occupancy and price
summary: Two connected spaces and flexible bedding for families travelling together.
description:
The Family Suite is built for togetherness, with flexible bedding and enough room for parents and children to settle in comfortably.

Thoughtful touches — extra storage, blackout curtains and a roomy bathroom — make multi-day family stays easy and restful.
